text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san.
Thank you for letting me rest yesterday.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Were you able to rest, Trainer-san?
Thanks to you,
I was able to take it easy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I went to a diner with my family...
I couldn't get seconds, but
I was able to eat more than usual.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'll introduce some of my recommended menu items to you next time, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems K.S.Miracle
enjoyed a pleasant rest.
